name: Four Towers
title: Four Towers
summary: 'A Walled Fortress without doors', entered by the Four Towers Entrance portal 61 m north; 'there is a LS inside' (acpedia). In the kit: four 31 m spire towers (0x01001161, top 154.75) at the corners of a 36 m walled square on a flat grass plain (z 124); inside the courtyard burn a bonfire, with the Life Stone, a well and Dizah ibn Nadqab's camp gear. The kit models each quarter (tower + wall) as one 31 m prism, so courtyard views are taken from straight above.

site.name: Four Towers
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer four-towers-entrance (inside the courtyard, 6 m from the centre, outdoor cell 0x828E001E).

shots.standingOrder: Arc 22 m round the west-north-west of the Four Towers 110 m out and 38 m up while the sky clock runs and clouds race over the spires; keep 14 m from the tree crowns, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Hyperlapse arc from the west-north-west: the four spires against a running sky (rate 0.008 game-days/s, sun 0.67 to about 0.74), clouds racing over the fortress on the empty plain.
